title: Locksmith Warranty Request Form
subtitle: Control authority verification, access service, key control, testing, and secure release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete locksmith service warranty request for openings, locks, keys, credentials, closers, and access devices. It connects verified access authority and approved security scope to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a locksmith dispatcher must investigate a locksmith service warranty or callback without treating the request as a coverage decision before identity, chronology, condition, and evidence are reviewed.

sections.title: Locksmith warranty exception and escalation
sections.guidance: Route unsafe, disputed, missing-evidence, third-party, or out-of-scope conditions without implying a coverage outcome.

blocks.label: Locksmith exception and stop-work indicators
items: Identity, occupancy, ownership, management, agency, or access authority disputed
Requested opening, vehicle, safe, key, or credential exceeds approved scope
Fire-rated, egress, panic, emergency-access, or shared-opening function uncertain
Master-key hierarchy, restricted keyway, or credential population may be affected
Alarm, access-control, intercom, power, or life-safety integration unavailable
Door, frame, glass, hinge, closer, structure, or finish may be damaged
Key, blank, core, credential, code, or removed-hardware custody discrepancy
Opening cannot be secured during or after work
Evidence of forced entry, tampering, crime, or safety concern requires escalation
Customer requests reusable security secrets in unrestricted notes or communications
blocks.guidance: Select the observed condition; do not use a generic exception when the actual trigger is known.

blocks.label: Exception containment, decision, and escalation register

sections.title: Locksmith warranty request closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This locksmith service warranty request is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when identity, access authority, property scope, key control, alarm integration, fire egress, security function, or credential custody is uncertain. A locksmith, security, or egress supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
